mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.post_id AS CHAR) postId,p.post_name postName,CAST(p.place_id AS CHAR) placeId, p.contact_name contactName,p.contact_phone contactPhone, COALESCE(f.name,'') placeName,p.status,p.sort_order sortOrder,p.revision,p.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fire_inspection_post_camera c WHERE c.post_id=p.post_id AND c.status='0') cameraCount, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.inspect_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') FROM fire_inspection_record r WHERE r.post_id=p.post_id ORDER BY r.inspect_time DESC,r.record_id DESC LIMIT 1) lastTime, (SELECT r.result FROM fire_inspection_record r WHERE r.post_id=p.post_id ORDER BY r.inspect_time DESC,r.record_id DESC LIMIT 1) lastResult FROM fire_inspection_post p LEFT JOIN fire_place f ON f.place_id=p.place_id WHERE 1=1 AND p.post_id=#{id} AND p.status=#{status} AND (p.post_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR f.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ${params.dataScope} ORDER BY p.sort_order,p.post_id
